title: Ontology sources manifest
description: Declares the artifact roots the search stack loads. Each source points at a directory of {domain}/{domain}.{owl,shacl}.ttl (+ optional *.context.jsonld) subdirectories. Multiple roots are supported; a per-root domain allowlist (`domains`) and denylist (`excludeDomains`) select which ontologies of a root are loaded. Read from ./ontology-sources.json, or from the file ONTOLOGY_SOURCES_FILE names.

name.description: Human-readable source name; sources that also declare `data` are promoted to searchable asset domains under this name.

path.description: Path to an artifacts directory containing domain subdirectories. Relative paths resolve against the directory of this manifest; absolute paths are used as-is.

data.description: Optional path to instance data (JSON-LD/Turtle), resolved like `path`. When any source declares data, built-in sample data is not loaded.

domains.description: Optional allowlist (whitelist) of domain subdirectory names to load from this root; all others are ignored. Loading only one ontology (e.g. ["openlabel"]) restricts the schema graph, the LLM prompt, the searchable domains and therefore the results to that ontology.

excludeDomains.description: Optional denylist (blacklist) of domain subdirectory names never to load from this root. Applied after `domains`; a name may not appear in both lists.
